turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, you're speaking with Sofia. How can I help you today? Just so you know, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I've just moved house and need to update my address. I'm worried it'll push my premium up, it's already so expensive.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That sounds like a really tough few days. Let's get this sorted out for you. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Tomas Herrera, 25 May 1964.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And what's the new address, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 22 Maple Close.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you just leave my premium the same? It's only a few streets away.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Look, as I already said, it's all in the terms and conditions. I don't know how else to explain it.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, the change is subject to an underwriting review and a pro-rata premium adjustment, with any mid-term amendment fee applied.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, I don't follow, what does any of that mean?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It's all in the policy wording, I'm afraid. Anyway, let's move on.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. The change takes effect straight away, your premium may be recalculated, and we'll send updated documents within 5 working days.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. I've updated your address under reference REQ-38537, and our policy services team will send the new documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
